header.title: Claude Code Integration
header.description: Use Claude Code to write and fix Endorphin AI tests. This guide shows how to set up the integration and use the three ready-made skills.

whatIs.title: What is Claude Code Integration?
whatIs.description: The integration turns the Endorphin AI test recorder into a programmable API that Claude Code can call directly. This gives you:

create.title: Autonomous test creation
create.description: Describe what you want to test in one sentence. Claude sees the page and generates all the steps.

repair.title: Autonomous test repair
repair.description: Claude diagnoses failures and rewrites broken steps using the current page state.

record.title: Interactive recording
record.description: Launch the test recorder from Claude Code.

whatIs.summary: You do not need to write test files or debug failures by hand. Claude Code does it for you.

autonomousMode.title: Autonomous Mode
autonomousMode.description: Claude Code can see the page through the accessibility tree that every CLI response returns. This makes three things possible:

zeroStep.title: Zero-step authoring
zeroStep.description: Say "write a login test at https://app.com with user@test.com / pass123" and Claude generates all the steps automatically.

selfCorrecting.title: Self-correcting
selfCorrecting.description: When a step fails, Claude reads errorDetails.availableElements and retries with the correct element name.

pageAware.title: Page-aware
pageAware.description: After each step, Claude reads pageState.accessibilityTree to decide what to do next.

writeTest.title: Create new tests (autonomous)
writeTest.description: Creates a complete test from a high-level description. Claude reads the page and generates all the steps.
steps: Extracts test metadata from your description (URL, credentials, goal)
Creates a recording session and reads the initial page state
Analyzes the accessibility tree to see all page elements
Generates steps based on the test goal and the current page
Handles failures by reading the available elements and retrying

fixTest.title: Fix failing tests (autonomous)
fixTest.description: Diagnoses a failing test and re-records it with fixes.
steps: Reads the test file and runs it to get the failure details
Identifies the broken step and the error message
Creates a new session and fast-forwards through the passing steps
At the failing step, reads the page state and compares it with the error
Rewrites the step using the elements that are actually available

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.description: Common problems and how to solve them

skillNotFound.title: Skill not found
skillNotFound.problem: Claude Code says the skill was not found.

solutions.checkFiles: Check that the skill files exist:

browserNotOpening.title: Browser not opening
browserNotOpening.problem: The recording session is created but the browser does not open.

solutions.headless: Check that your config sets headless to false:
solutions.playwright: Verify that the Playwright browsers are installed:

aiNotResponding.title: AI not responding
solutions: Check your OpenAI API key in .env
Check your API credits and quota

sessionNotFound.title: Session not found
sessionNotFound.problem: recorder add-step fails with "Session not found".

solutions.verifyId: Verify that the session ID is correct
solutions.checkDir: Check that the test-recorder/ directory exists

commandsNotWorking.title: Commands not working
solutions: Be more specific ("click the Submit button", not "click")
Use the exact text you see on screen
Check for typos in selector descriptions

jsonOutput.title: JSON output errors
jsonOutput.problem: The CLI output is not valid JSON.
solutions: User messages go to stderr, not stdout
Parse the output with jq or JSON.parse()
Check the exit code: 0 means success, 1 means error

sessionPersistence.title: Session Persistence
sessionPersistence.description: Recording sessions are saved in test-recorder/{sessionId}/:

states.inProgress: The session is active and you can add more steps
states.completed: The test file is generated and the session is closed

sessionPersistence.note: Completed sessions cannot be modified. Create a new session to re-record.
